page.title: Registry
page.description: Namespaces, packages and tokens across all users.

filter.placeholder: Filter by owner, namespace or slug

namespaces.empty: No namespace has been assigned yet.
namespaces.suspendDescription: This takes everything published by {{owner}} out of service until the namespace is restored. Nothing is deleted.
namespaces.suspendEffectFeed: The read feed answers 404 for every package of the namespace, so clients can no longer install or update them.
namespaces.suspendEffectOwner: The owner becomes read-only: no new packages, versions, uploads or settings changes.
namespaces.suspendEffectTokens: The owner's access tokens are refused.
namespaces.restoreDescription: The packages of {{owner}} are served again, and the owner and their tokens can publish again.

quota.title: Quota
quota.hint: Override the limits for this user. Leave a field empty to use the platform default.
quota.invalid: Enter a whole number, zero or greater, or leave the field empty.
quota.assetInvalid: Enter a whole number greater than zero, or leave the field empty.
quota.assetTooLarge: The single asset limit cannot exceed 500 MiB.

userPicker.title: Quota for another user
userPicker.description: Pick a user to view and change their quota, including one who has no namespace yet.
userPicker.more: Showing the first matches only. Refine the search to narrow the list.

packages.empty: No package has been created yet.
packages.hint: To take everything of one publisher out of service at once, suspend their namespace:
packages.makePrivateDescription: {{package}} of {{owner}} will no longer be served to anonymous clients. The owner can make it public again.
packages.deleteDescription: {{package}} of {{owner}} will be deleted with all its versions and assets. This cannot be undone.

tokens.showAll: Show the tokens of all users
tokens.revokeDescription: The token "{{name}}" of {{owner}} stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
